subject: behavioral
keyPoints: Each story is STAR in about 2 minutes: situation in one line, most of the time on what I did (first person, not "we") and a result I can defend, ending with one thing I'd do differently; if I don't remember a number, describe it without one.

subject: sql
keyPoints: An index helps only when the predicate is sargable on its leading column: a function on the column (date_trunc, lower) defeats it, so use a half-open range or an expression index; a low-selectivity filter is faster as a seq scan; a covering index gives Index Only Scan after VACUUM; always predict the plan, then run EXPLAIN.

subject: sql
keyPoints: RANK ties share a rank and skip numbers after (1,1,1,4); ROW_NUMBER never ties (1,2,3) so rank=1 would drop tied top earners; DENSE_RANK has no gaps, so = 2 gives the second-highest distinct salary (178). In a LEFT JOIN, a filter on the right table goes in ON, not WHERE: WHERE (even with OR IS NULL) drops users whose only orders fail the filter (1158).
